ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and GAM forecasting model predicting local campus resource bottlenecks and power outages based on historical weather and grid load data.
ideas.title: KalyaniCampus-AI-Incident-Watch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact mathematical rigor of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winner by applying robust statistical modeling to a tangible local infrastructure problem.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring tool designed to track agricultural land encroachment and crop health anomalies specific to rural West Bengal regions.
ideas.title: AgriNex-Satellite-Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of the GeoNex-ATLAS win at Xcelerate Hackathon by providing localized, high-impact spatial intelligence that regional judges immediately understand and value.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven patient trust and acquisition platform tailored for local diagnostic centers and small clinics in semi-urban West Bengal.
ideas.title: BangaCare-Patient-Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the rapid, localized value proposition of the Global-Smile 12-hour hackathon winner by solving client acquisition for local medical practitioners.

ideas.pitch: Coordinated logistics app that groups elderly residents in Kalyani into safe social outings with verified student volunteer drivers.
ideas.title: SeniorLink-Kalyani
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven formula of the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon grand prize winner by addressing a clear social isolation pain point with a localized logistical solution.

ideas.pitch: Localized nutrition assistant providing macro tracking and healthy meal recommendations adapted strictly to traditional Bengali cuisine and locally available ingredients.
ideas.title: NutriBanga-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on the user-centric appeal of the Hour Hackathon nutrition winner by offering hyper-localized dietary insights that resonate personally with the local judging panel.
